props.description: Controls the radius of the inner circle at the center of the chart

props.description: Angle in degrees from which the chart should start

props.name: strokeColor
props.description: Controls color of the sectors stroke, by default depends on color scheme

props.description: A function to format values inside the tooltip and labels
